notes: Painter call streams in the tools/golden/recordingPainter.ts format. HUD cases: a fresh HUDEntity per case and size; per frame update(delta), performance.now = nowMs, then render2D on a PerspectiveCamera with the recorded pose and projection (no parent, unit scale). player = what the PlayerEntity stub returns (display pose; angleOfAttack in rad; fcsPitchLimiterMode 1..3 or other); stats are the perf globals (cloud = cloud + cirrus). Exterior: one update + render2D. Perf: update(d) for each delta, then render2D with the __kernelStats / __drawStats (values in order) / __terrainStats globals. Device status: renderAircraftDeviceStatus at getAircraftDeviceStatusPosition, colour #66FF66.
